invariants_created: Host header is mandatory in every HTTP/1.1 request
Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding must be present when request has a body
POST, PUT, PATCH requests should include Content-Type header when body is present
HEAD response must not include a body
OPTIONS * is a server-level options request where path equals asterisk
Requests must follow the sequence: METHOD /path HTTP/1.1, then headers, then optional blank line, then optional body
Responses must start with HTTP/1.1 <status-code> <reason-phrase>, then headers, then optional blank line, then optional body
Location header is required in 3xx redirect responses
Connection: close signals connection will be closed after the response
RESPONSE_4XX.Retry-After: optional for 429 Too Many Requests

PATCH.template:
PATCH /path HTTP/1.1
Host: <host>
Content-Type: <mime>
Content-Length: <n>
[User-Agent: <agent>]
[Authorization: <creds>]
[Cookie: <cookie>]
[Connection: keep-alive|close]

<body>
